scope.token_universe: quote-selected subset in root analysis; full wallet token universe unknown

requirements.requirement: Historical standard-binary CTF Exchange, ConditionalTokens, USDC.e addresses, decimals, ABI, deployed code hash and active-version block intervals. No NegRisk events silently pooled.

Canonical first block timestamp >= START and first block timestamp >= END. Opening state at start_block-1; closing state at end_block-1. Preserve predecessor/successor headers to establish boundaries.

Every included block header hash, parent hash, number and timestamp; every receipt transactionHash, transactionIndex, logIndex, status and emitting contract. Include only canonical successful transfers.
Freeze tracked collateral-holding proxy/safe addresses and token universe before performance labels; label token subset versus full-wallet scope.
Archive eth_call balanceOf(address) at exact opening and closing block for USDC.e; record raw hex/result and decimals. No current balance substitution.
Archive ERC1155 balanceOf(address,tokenId), or balanceOfBatch, at both boundaries for every scoped token; completeness of token universe explicit.
All USDC.e Transfer logs involving tracked addresses for [start_block,end_block), including exchange, mint, merge, redemption and external funding routes.
All TransferSingle/TransferBatch logs involving tracked addresses; expand batch ids/values, include zero-address mint/burn and transfers unrelated to exchange.
Complete receipts for transactions involving scoped tokens/collateral/addresses, not only one topic; explain intermediate exchange/adapter flows and refunds.
OrderFilled and OrdersMatched logs with order hashes, integer maker/taker asset amounts, asset IDs, fee and emitted addresses; individual and aggregate fills not posted twice.

Relevant PositionSplit, PositionsMerge, PayoutRedemption, ConditionPreparation and ConditionResolution logs with original integer values, collateralToken, parentCollectionId, partition/indexSets and payout vectors.
Historical payoutDenominator/payoutNumerators before and after resolution; token-to-condition mapping, outcomeSlotCount and root/parent collection; metadata as known at cutoff.
Classify every collateral delta into economic trade/lifecycle/fee/reward/external transfer using receipt context; unknown classification remains unknown.

Identify fee recipient, actual fee asset, integer fee quantities, rebates and payer; gas charged only if borne by tracked address. Native-token gas requires its own valuation if included in net metric.
Transfer-derived balances equal independently fetched endpoint balances exactly in native asset units; contract-only reserve/status not added to cash.
Request parameters, access time, dataset revision when supported, byte lengths and SHA256; schema/decoder versions; retry coverage and unresolved gaps.
Same-token full snapshots+deltas, known sequence/gaps, receivedAt and source clock, full depth after signal, spread/fee rules, data through horizon and sufficient terminal liquidation depth.
Leader holdings immediately before sell reconstructed from all relevant token flows; sell reduction ratio only computed with known positive denominator.
Separate virtual $200 starting cash and zero holdings, all fills, fees, rejected/unknown orders, reservations, partials, sells, settlements and carry-over; no invented cash replenishment.

acceptance_checks.equation: C_end = C_start + sum(ERC20 received units) - sum(ERC20 sent units)
Q_end[token] = Q_start[token] + sum(ERC1155 received units) - sum(ERC1155 sent units)
A transfer from tracked address to itself has net delta zero; still preserve log
For v1 BUY, received outcome units reconcile to taking minus fee; for SELL received collateral reconciles likewise, including actual refunds. Verify deployed code.
Transfer logs are posted exactly once; fill/CTF explanatory records do not add a second delta
For root binary partition [1,2], split amount x consumes x collateral and mints x each side; merge reverses. Other partitions require full contract semantics.
Economic PnL = terminal observed liquidation equity - opening observed liquidation equity - net external capital inflow
